members.working:
Need diamagnetic species with d²sp³ (inner-orbital octahedral) hybridisation.
1. [Cu(CN)₄]³⁻: Cu(I) d¹⁰, tetrahedral sp³ — not octahedral. ✗
2. [Co(H₂O)₆]³⁺: Co³⁺ d⁶; H₂O treated as weak field → high spin t₂g⁴eg², paramagnetic, sp³d². ✗
3. [Co(en)₃]³⁺: Co³⁺ d⁶, en strong field → low spin t₂g⁶, diamagnetic, d²sp³. ✓
4. [Ni(H₂O)₆]²⁺: Ni²⁺ d⁸, octahedral always has 2 unpaired (t₂g⁶eg²), paramagnetic, sp³d². ✗
5. [Ni(CO)₄]: Ni(0) d¹⁰, tetrahedral sp³, diamagnetic but not d²sp³. ✗
6. [CuCl₄]²⁻: Cu²⁺ d⁹, paramagnetic, tetrahedral. ✗
7. [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻: Fe²⁺ d⁶, CN⁻ strong field → low spin t₂g⁶, diamagnetic, d²sp³. ✓
8. [Co(CN)₆]³⁻: Co³⁺ d⁶, low spin t₂g⁶, diamagnetic, d²sp³. ✓
9. [Cr(NH₃)₆]³⁺: Cr³⁺ d³, t₂g³, diamagnetic (no unpaired), d²sp³. ✓
Total = 4.
